metadata.title: GSS Change Decomposition
metadata.source: General Social Survey cumulative file via gssr::gss_all
metadata.weight_note: All estimates use the selected GSS survey weight. Rows with missing or non-positive weights are dropped. socialchange::cr_ic receives that weight column, computes weighted year-cohort means, and normalizes weighted cohort proportions within each period before decomposing intracohort change and cohort replacement.
metadata.method: socialchange::cr_ic algebraic decomposition (AD): intracohort change plus cohort replacement
metadata.scale: Each response variable is mapped to a 0-100 reviewed scale using only substantive valid codes. 100 is the manually selected affirmative/agreement/approval/high-intensity end for the item wording, and 0 is the opposite end. Explicit other, missing, don't know, no-answer, refused, IAP, and not-available codes are excluded before scaling. Binary item scores equal the weighted percent choosing the Score 100 response. Ordered multi-category item scores are ordinal indices, not percentages; nominal categorical variables are not included.
